paper.title: Rethinking Batch in BatchNorm
paper.use: Fixed-feature population moments and layer order; domain choice matters. Target recalibration can help or hurt. No HSI benefit inferred.

upstream.classification: Meta official library linked by paper reference1
upstream.license_scope: Root text and actual file copyright header verified, no unrelated nested-source claim.

adaptation: Independent published-moment adaptation with torch.var_mean and eval-clone prehooks. Generic updater aggregates batches and mutates its model; this contract binds one full target scene, static label-free graph and exact state. No external trainer, split, dependency or benchmark imported.
local_policy: Correction0 moments per executed target BN, in forward order; pixels and region populations separate. Only running_mean/var change. Full-target context is transductive, not DG. Legacy source/joint calibration is untouched.
verification: Default-none, independent batch-statistics oracle, state/observation/graph binding, CPU/GPU and real3scene acceptance; accuracy remains a later paired experiment.
